Build SMS Candidate Outreach via Twilio for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`. Read `CLAUDE.md` first.

## IMPORTANT — Concurrency
Multiple other agents are modifying the codebase in parallel. DO NOT touch:
- `src/components/JobDetailView.tsx` (being modified by sequences agent)
- `src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx` (being modified by quality-of-hire agent)
- `src/components/CandidateRow.tsx` (being modified by duplicate-detection agent)
- `src/hooks/useRediscovery.ts`, `src/components/Rediscovery*.tsx`, `src/components/ScorecardTemplate*.tsx`
- Any `supabase/functions/send-sequence-step/`, `supabase/functions/enroll-in-sequence/`, `supabase/functions/find-duplicates/`, `supabase/functions/extension-capture/` (being built elsewhere)

SAFE to touch:
- `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppOutreachDialog.tsx` — pattern to copy
- New files anywhere
- New edge function `supabase/functions/send-sms/`

## The Feature
Add SMS sending via Twilio so recruiters can send interview reminders and updates to candidates via text message. Pattern mimics the existing WhatsApp dialog.

## Build Plan

### 1. NEW Edge Function: `supabase/functions/send-sms/index.ts`
- Pattern: follow `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`
- Auth: require authenticated user
- Body: `{ resume_id: string, job_id: string, to_phone: string, message: string }`
- Env vars expected: `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER`
- Call Twilio REST API: `POST https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{sid}/Messages.json`
  - Basic auth with SID + token
  - Form body: `To={to_phone}&From={TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER}&Body={message}`
- Log the send to a new `sms_logs` table (create in migration below)
- Return `{ success, twilio_sid?, error? }`
- Gracefully handle missing env vars (return 503 "SMS not configured")
- CORS headers standard pattern

### 2. NEW DB Migration: `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_sms_logs.sql`
```sql
create table sms_logs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  resume_id uuid references resumes(id) on delete set null,
  job_id uuid references jobs(id) on delete set null,
  to_phone text not null,
  message text not null,
  status text not null default 'pending', -- pending|sent|failed
  twilio_sid text,
  error text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

create index idx_sms_logs_user on sms_logs (user_id);
alter table sms_logs enable row level security;
create policy "Users see own sms logs" on sms_logs for select using (user_id = auth.uid());
create policy "Users insert own sms logs" on sms_logs for insert with check (user_id = auth.uid());
```

### 3. NEW Component: `src/components/candidate/SmsOutreachDialog.tsx`
- Pattern: copy `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppOutreachDialog.tsx` almost exactly
- Props: `{ open, onOpenChange, candidateName, candidatePhone, jobTitle, matchScore, resumeId, jobId }`
- Message templates (3 pre-built):
  1. "Interview invitation" — "Hi {name}, this is {recruiter} from {company}. We'd love to schedule an interview for the {role} position. Are you available this week?"
  2. "Application update" — "Hi {name}, thanks for applying to the {role} role. We're reviewing your profile and will be in touch within 48 hours."
  3. "Custom" — blank textarea
- Template picker at top
- Message preview area
- Character count (SMS best practice: <160 chars)
- "Send SMS" button calls edge function
- Loading state + success/error toasts
- Dialog uses shadcn Dialog primitive

### 4. NEW Hook: `src/hooks/useSms.ts`
- `useSendSms()` — React Query mutation
- Calls the `send-sms` edge function
- Invalidates sms_logs query on success

### 5. Integration
Since CandidateDetailSheet is off-limits during concurrent edits, create a new exportable helper function in `src/lib/smsLauncher.ts`:
- Export a function `openSmsDialog(props)` that mounts SmsOutreachDialog using React portal
- OR (preferred): document in a README that SmsOutreachDialog should be imported and mounted by whoever owns CandidateDetailSheet in a follow-up change

Actually — safer approach: just build the component and document the integration step. Don't integrate yet. Add this to the commit message: "NOTE: SmsOutreachDialog component ready for integration into CandidateDetailSheet header action row in a follow-up commit."

### 6. Admin settings integration
Check if there's an admin `IntegrationsTab.tsx` (look for `src/components/admin/IntegrationsTab.tsx`). If so, add a new section for Twilio configuration:
- Twilio Account SID input
- Twilio Auth Token input (password field)
- Twilio From Number input
- "Save" button → stores in Supabase Vault or the existing secrets mechanism the admin page uses (look at how OpenAI key is stored)
- "Test" button → sends a test SMS to a user-provided number

If adding to admin is complex or blocked by other agents, skip it and document the required env vars in the edge function README.

### 7. Create `supabase/functions/send-sms/README.md`
- Environment variables required
- How to get Twilio credentials
- How to deploy
- How to test

## Critical Requirements
- TypeScript strict mode, no `any` types (except `(supabase as any)` for new sms_logs table)
- Use shadcn-ui components only
- Use existing Supabase client from `@/integrations/supabase/client`
- Use React Query for all data fetching
- Auth check on edge function
- Mobile responsive
- Dark mode support
- Error handling with sonner toasts
- Run `npm run build` at the end to verify no type errors
- Commit and push when done with a clear commit message

## Reference Patterns
- Edge function with auth: `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`
- Dialog component: `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppOutreachDialog.tsx`

Build this end to end. Report what you built when finished.

1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes
15

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224

# send-sms Edge Function

Sends an SMS to a candidate via Twilio REST API and logs the result to the `sms_logs` table.

## Environment Variables Required

Set all three in **Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → Edge Functions → Secrets**:

| Secret | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` | Your Twilio Account SID — found in the Twilio Console dashboard |
| `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` | Your Twilio Auth Token — found in the Twilio Console dashboard |
| `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` | Your Twilio phone number in E.164 format (e.g. `+15551234567`) |

If any of these secrets are missing, the function returns `503` with `not_configured: true`.

## How to Get Twilio Credentials

1. Sign up at https://www.twilio.com/try-twilio
2. Go to **Console Dashboard** — your Account SID and Auth Token are displayed
3. Go to **Phone Numbers → Buy a Number** — purchase a number with SMS capability
4. Copy the number in E.164 format (e.g. `+15551234567`)

## Request Body

```json
{
  "resume_id": "uuid",
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "to_phone": "+447911123456",
  "message": "Hi Jane, we'd love to schedule an interview for the Engineering role. Are you available this week?"
}
```

All four fields are required. `to_phone` must be in E.164 format (e.g. `+447911123456`).

## Response

**Success:**
```json
{ "success": true, "twilio_sid": "SM..." }
```

**SMS not configured:**
```json
{ "error": "SMS not configured. Set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID...", "not_configured": true }
```
(HTTP 503)

**Twilio error:**
```json
{ "error": "Twilio error (status 400, code 21211)" }
```
(HTTP 502)

## Database Logging

Every send attempt (success or failure) is written to `sms_logs`:

```sql
select * from sms_logs order by created_at desc limit 20;
```

## Deploy

```bash
supabase functions deploy send-sms
```

## Test Locally

```bash
supabase functions serve send-sms --env-file .env.local

curl -X POST http://localhost:54321/functions/v1/send-sms \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "resume_id": "<resume-uuid>",
    "job_id": "<job-uuid>",
    "to_phone": "+15551234567",
    "message": "Hi there, we would like to schedule an interview."
  }'
```

---

## What was built

### DB Migration
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/supabase/migrations/20260412000000_sms_logs.sql`

New `sms_logs` table with columns: `id, user_id, resume_id, job_id, to_phone, message, status (pending|sent|failed), twilio_sid, error, created_at`. RLS policies restrict each user to their own rows. Four indexes: user, resume, job, created_at.

### Edge Function
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/supabase/functions/send-sms/index.ts`

Follows the `send-candidate-email` pattern exactly: JWT auth check first, validates all four required body fields, reads `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` / `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` / `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` from Deno env, returns `503 not_configured: true` if any are missing, calls Twilio REST API with Basic auth, logs every attempt (success or failure) to `sms_logs`, surfaces Twilio error messages to the caller, uses `logSystemError` from `_shared/logError.ts` for any failures.

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/supabase/functions/send-sms/README.md` — setup guide with required env vars, Twilio account setup steps, example curl test.

### React Query Hook
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/hooks/useSms.ts`

`useSendSms()` — typed mutation (`SendSmsInput` / `SendSmsResult`), invokes the edge function, invalidates `sms_logs` query keys on success.

### Dialog Component
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/candidate/SmsOutreachDialog.tsx`

Props: `{ open, onOpenChange, candidateName, candidatePhone, jobTitle, matchScore, resumeId, jobId }`. Three templates: Interview Invitation, Application Update, Custom. Character counter that shows segment count when over 160 chars and turns amber/red. "No phone number" warning state. Loading spinner on send button during mutation. Handles `not_configured` error with an admin-directed message. Uses `useSendSms` hook, shadcn Dialog/Select/Textarea/Button, Sonner toasts.

### Admin Integrations Tab
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/admin/IntegrationsTab.tsx`

Added `TwilioCard` — same collapsible pattern as OpenAI/Resend/Dodo cards. Shows three required secrets as `SecretRow` components, full setup guide with numbered steps, and a test-send panel where the admin enters an E.164 phone number and fires a real test SMS via the edge function.

### Integration note
`SmsOutreachDialog` is ready to be mounted by whoever next modifies `CandidateDetailSheet` — import it and add an SMS button to the header action row alongside the existing WhatsApp button.

### Deploy steps
```bash
supabase db push  # applies the migration
supabase functions deploy send-sms
# then add TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER in Supabase → Project Settings → Edge Functions → Secrets
```
